workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: standalone Telegram send (hermes send) uses PTB default read_timeout=5s — media sends report 'Timed out' although delivered (duplicates on retry)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(telegram): media uploads wait for Telegram's answer instead of reporting a delivered file as failed (#133093, #133164, #117795, salvage #133117). Target files: cron/scheduler_delivery.py, cron/scheduler_script.py, gateway/platforms/helpers.py. Before: a file sent to Telegram could reach the chat while Hermes reported "Timed out" / "Couldn't deliver the file attachment", because Hermes stopped waiting for Telegram's answer after a fixed 60s (gateway) or 20s (`hermes send`), whatever the file size. Now an uploa... (Ref: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/151797)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Async delegate child dies with KeyError(<parent session id>) once the parent's live session is gone (inherited local-viewer print sink)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(gateway): recover from a background subagent's failure while its parent chat is idle. Target files: gateway/run_notifications.py, gateway/session_authority.py, gateway/session_automation.py. When Hermes hands a job to a helper agent and that helper fails, for example because the AI provider's safety filter refused the request, the main conversation used to stay silent until you came back and asked what happened. Worse, the real reason was sometimes lost and replaced by a meaningless error. Now the failure com... (Ref: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/149568)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: connect_tracked: a tracked connection garbage-collected without close() stays "live" in the registry until restart
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(state): release a tracked connection's entry only after SQLite has closed its files. Target files: hermes_cli/sqlite_safe_read.py, tests/hermes_cli/test_sqlite_safe_read_finalizer.py. Makes a tracked SQLite connection release its registry entry when it's garbage-collected without `close()`, and never before its files are actually closed. (Ref: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/149309)

workarounds.symptom: xAI grok-4.7 compression no-ops on encrypted reasoning, then structural_backoff blocks retry
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Long Codex, xAI and Claude chats no longer hide their reasoning from compression (#125920). Target files: agent/context_compressor.py, agent/context_compressor_tail.py, agent/message_metadata.py. On Codex, xAI and Claude, the model's hidden reasoning from earlier turns is sent back on every call, and the provider bills for it. Hermes counted that reasoning as zero (or, for Claude, as its much shorter summary), so compression thought a heavy session was small, found "nothing to cut" and blocked itself, while the r... (Ref: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/152422)
